title: समकालीन नेपाली गजलमा प्रतीक [Symbol in contemporary Nepali Ghazals]
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख समकालीन नेपाली गजलमा प्रयोग भएका प्रमुख प्रतीकहरूको खोजी गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार पारिएको हो । यसमा वि.सं. २०३६ सालदेखि हालसम्मको नेपाली गजलयात्रालाई समकालीन नेपाली गजल मानिएको छ । गुणात्मक ढाँचामा संरक्षित यस लेखमा सोद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनौट विधि र दस्तावेज विश्लेषण गरेर तथ्यहरू सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । सामग्री छनोटको सैद्धान्तिक आधार प्रतीक प्रयोग गरिएका सेरहरुलाई बनाइएको छ । यस लेखमा यस अवधिका गजलमा सांस्कृतिक, प्राकृतिक र सैद्धान्तिक गरी तिन प्रकारका प्रतीकहरू प्रयोग भएको देखाइएको छ । यसरी प्रतीक प्रयोग समकालीन नेपाली गजलको एउटा महत्वपूर्ण प्राप्ति र विशेषता दुबै बनेको छ । यस लेखमा प्रतीक प्रयोग भएका गजलका केही सेरहरूको विश्लेषणबाट समकालीन नेपाली गजलमा प्रतीकहरूको प्रयोगमा विविधता रहेको र त्यसले नेपाली गजललाई समृद्ध बनाएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This article has been prepared with the aim of exploring the principal symbols used in contemporary Nepali ghazals. In it, the journey of the Nepali ghazal from V.S. 2036 to the present has been taken as the contemporary Nepali ghazal. In this article, grounded in a qualitative framework, the facts have been collected through purposive sampling and document analysis. The theoretical basis for the selection of the material has been taken to be the sheras in which symbols are used. In this article it is shown that in the ghazals of this period three kinds of symbols are used — cultural, natural and theoretical. In this way, the use of symbols has become both an important achievement and a characteristic of the contemporary Nepali ghazal. In this article, from the analysis of some sheras of ghazals that use symbols, the conclusion is drawn that there is diversity in the use of symbols in the contemporary Nepali ghazal, and that this has enriched the Nepali ghazal.

australian_english: This article has been put together to take a good look at the main symbols used in contemporary Nepali ghazals. In it, the journey of the Nepali ghazal from V.S. 2036 through to today is taken as the contemporary Nepali ghazal. This article, grounded in a qualitative framework, gathers its facts by way of purposive sampling and document analysis. The theoretical basis for choosing the material has been taken to be the sheras in which symbols get used. In this article it is shown that the ghazals of this period use three kinds of symbols — cultural, natural and theoretical. That way, the use of symbols has ended up as both an important achievement and a defining feature of the contemporary Nepali ghazal. In this article, from the analysis of some symbol-using sheras of ghazals, the conclusion is drawn that the use of symbols in the contemporary Nepali ghazal is diverse, and that this has enriched the Nepali ghazal.
informal_english: This piece sets out to have a look at the main symbols showing up in contemporary Nepali ghazals. In it, the whole journey of the Nepali ghazal from V.S. 2036 right up to now counts as the contemporary Nepali ghazal. It's built on a qualitative setup, and the facts were pulled together using purposive sampling and document analysis. The theoretical basis for picking the material was the sheras where symbols are used. What this piece shows is that, in the ghazals of this period, three kinds of symbols get used — cultural, natural and theoretical. So, symbol use has ended up as both a big achievement and a hallmark of the contemporary Nepali ghazal. And from digging into a few symbol-using sheras of ghazals, this piece lands on the conclusion that there's real variety in how symbols are used in the contemporary Nepali ghazal, and that this has made the Nepali ghazal richer overall.
translator_notes: 'शेर' (ghazal couplet) is transliterated as 'shera'; 'वि.सं. २०३६' kept as V.S. 2036 (Vikram Samvat), not converted to AD. 'सैद्धान्तिक' in the source list of symbol types (सांस्कृतिक, प्राकृतिक र सैद्धान्तिक) is rendered as 'theoretical' as printed, though it likely intends a third named category of symbol; left literal rather than guessed. 'गुणात्मक ढाँचामा संरक्षित' read as 'grounded/situated in a qualitative framework' (संरक्षित is unusual here; possibly a misprint for समाविष्ट/स्थित). 'सेर' / 'सेरहरु' read as shera (sher). Strict sentence order kept. Informal variant rendered in British casual flavour.
